dql.script:
parse content, "JSON:json"
| fieldsAdd audit.identity = coalesce(json[principal_name], json[principal_id])
| fieldsAdd audit.time = toTimestamp(json[event_ts])
| fieldsAdd client.ip = json[src]
| fieldsAdd browser.user_agent = json[user_agent]
| fieldsAdd trace_id = json[trace_id]
| fieldsAdd log.record.uid = concat(toString(json[trace_id]), "_", toString(json[rt]))
| fieldsAdd timestamp = toTimestamp(toLong(asNumber(json[rt])) * 1000000)
| fieldsAdd log.source = "kong-audit-webhook"
| fieldsAdd cloud.provider = "konghq"
| fieldsAdd kong.konnect.org.id = json[org_id]
| fieldsAdd kong.konnect.sig = json[sig]
| fieldsAdd kong.konnect.initiated = json[kong_initiated]

dql.script:
parse content, "JSON{LD:event_class_id,LD:name:auth_outcome,BOOL:success}(flat=true)"
| fieldsAdd konnect_format = "authentication"
| fieldsAdd audit.action = if(event_class_id == "AUTHENTICATION_TYPE_BASIC", "Basic Authentication", else: if(event_class_id == "AUTHENTICATION_TYPE_SSO", "SSO Authentication", else: if(event_class_id == "AUTHENTICATION_TYPE_PAT", "PAT Authentication", else: event_class_id)))
| fieldsAdd audit.result = if(success == true, "Succeeded", else: "Failed")
| fieldsAdd audit.status = if(auth_outcome == "AUTHENTICATION_OUTCOME_SUCCESS", "Succeeded", else: if(auth_outcome == "AUTHENTICATION_OUTCOME_LOCKED", "Active", else: if(auth_outcome == "AUTHENTICATION_OUTCOME_DISABLED", "Active", else: "Failed")))
| fieldsRemove event_class_id, auth_outcome, success

parse content, "JSON{LD:action,BOOL:granted,LD:actor_id}(flat=true)"
| fieldsAdd konnect_format = "authorization"
| fieldsAdd audit.action = action
| fieldsAdd audit.result = if(granted == true, "Succeeded", else: "Failed")
| fieldsAdd audit.status = if(granted == true, "Succeeded", else: "Failed")
| fieldsAdd kong.konnect.actor.id = actor_id
| fieldsRemove action, granted, actor_id

parse content, "JSON{LD:act,LD:request,INT:status:access_status}(flat=true)"
| fieldsAdd konnect_format = "access"
| fieldsAdd audit.action = if(isNotNull(request), concat(act, " ", request), else: act)
| fieldsAdd audit.result = if(access_status >= 200 and access_status < 300, "Succeeded", else: "Failed")
| fieldsAdd audit.status = if(access_status >= 200 and access_status < 300, "Succeeded", else: "Failed")
| fieldsAdd result.code = toLong(access_status)
| fieldsRemove act, request, access_status

fieldsAdd status = if(audit.result == "Failed", "ERROR", else: "INFO")
| fieldsAdd loglevel = status
